name: Kshitij Ashok Sawarkar
title: Autonomous Robotics, Embedded Systems & Forward Deployed Engineering
summary: Autonomous systems and forward-deployed automation engineer with an M.Tech in Control and Instrumentation from MNNIT Allahabad and a B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering from RCOEM Nagpur. Operates at the intersection of embedded hardware, deterministic edge runtimes, real-time computer vision, and industrial systems automation. Lead author of peer-reviewed edge-perception research published in IEEE Xplore (Document ID: 10627276). Proven track record of delivering production-grade client-side engines executing under 50ms latency (npl-automation.pages.dev), software-defined radio (SDR) spectral sensing pipelines for UAV RF classification, and ROS2 embedded robotics control stacks.

highlights: Architected and deployed a production client-side application (npl-automation.pages.dev) on Cloudflare Pages, automating multi-tier Finished Goods (FG) code generation and New Product Launch (NPL) schema logic across complex seater variants and dynamic colorways.

Eliminated multi-day manual ERP spreadsheet reconciliation bottlenecks by implementing recursive client-side parsing algorithms, compressing end-to-end BOM derivation from 72+ operational hours into deterministic sub-minute runs with sub-50ms execution latency.

Authored formal system constraints (AGENTS.md) and deterministic validation guardrails, preventing parameter collisions, duplicate SKU generation, and upstream ERP data ingestion errors across active manufacturing assembly lines.

Engineered the entire schema pipeline to execute strictly client-side with 100% data isolation and zero server compute overhead, eliminating cloud infrastructure maintenance and ensuring uninterrupted offline plant-floor readiness.

Architected and executed the migration of local machine learning workflows and structured datasets to AWS infrastructure, configuring EC2 instances, security groups, and IAM role policies for distributed execution.

Designed asynchronous, serverless ETL data pipelines using AWS Lambda triggered by Amazon S3 bucket storage events, automating data ingestion, validation, and real-time preprocessing with zero idle compute costs.

Managed full model training lifecycles and deployed hosted inference endpoints using AWS SageMaker, optimizing distributed algorithms (XGBoost, Linear Learner) for scalable real-time inference against production datasets.
Implemented CloudWatch monitoring, automated alerts, and resource scaling policies to ensure continuous endpoint availability while preventing resource waste.
Developed embedded firmware and sensor interfacing routines across microcontrollers and IoT development boards for connected hardware products incubated under Sharon Innovations.

Integrated serial communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C) to link environmental and operational sensors with edge communication modules, ensuring low-power telemetry transmission with zero packet loss.
Built internal test automation scripts and hardware debugging routines to profile voltage stability, sensor drift, and signal noise across early prototype iterations.
Resolved hardware-software integration bottlenecks across partner ventures, increasing overall prototype operational reliability prior to pilot field trials.

Configured and provisioned enterprise routing hardware, managed Layer 2 and Layer 3 (L2/L3) network switches, and established static and dynamic routing topologies across regional distribution points.
Implemented IPv4 CIDR subnetting, VLAN segmentation, and DHCP/DNS server configurations to isolate operational traffic and optimize bandwidth allocation across mixed client networks.

Conducted physical Layer 1 and Layer 2 troubleshooting using packet-capture analyzers and cable-fault testers, identifying signal attenuation, packet drops, and MTU mismatch bottlenecks across physical trunk lines.
Built and deployed automated network monitoring check-scripts to trace gateway latency, resolve broadcast storms, and maintain high-availability network operations for downstream distribution nodes.

flagship_projects.name: Real-Time Drone Detection & RF Signal Classification
highlights: Built an automated edge spectral sensing pipeline intercepting communication bursts between commercial UAV flight controllers and Ground Control Stations (GCS) across 2.4 GHz and 5.8 GHz ISM bands.

Configured Software-Defined Radio (SDR) hardware to stream raw I/Q signal data, applying Fast Fourier Transforms (FFT) and spectrogram processing to isolate low-power transmission spikes against ambient radio noise.
Trained lightweight neural classification models to differentiate drone telemetry from Wi-Fi/Bluetooth interference with sub-second classification latency.

flagship_projects.name: Manufacturing Schema & BOM Automation Engine (NPL Automation)
highlights: Engineered an industrial client-side schema engine deployed on Cloudflare Pages, automating multi-tier Finished Goods (FG) code generation and New Product Launch (NPL) parameter trees across dynamic seater variants and colorways.

Solved combinatorial explosion bottlenecks using recursive client-side parsing algorithms, compressing 72+ operational hours of manual ERP reconciliation into deterministic sub-minute execution with sub-50ms latency.
Authored formal system constraints (AGENTS.md) and deterministic validation guardrails to prevent SKU collisions and upstream ERP data ingestion errors across active manufacturing assembly lines.
Structured zero-compute infrastructure running 100% client-side with full data isolation and zero server overhead.

flagship_projects.name: Smart Shopping Cart: Real-Time Edge Object Detection
highlights: Curated a custom retail dataset and fine-tuned YOLOv5 models for multi-class edge detection running directly on ARM-constrained Raspberry Pi hardware.
Implemented INT8 model parameter quantization and cache optimization to balance thermal throttling limits against frames-per-second (FPS) throughput.
Designed an OpenCV pipeline executing local billing logic with zero server dependencies, guaranteeing full offline operational readiness.
Published as Lead Author in IEEE Xplore (Document ID: 10627276).

flagship_projects.name: HiWonder MentorPi M1 Autonomous Robotics Platform
highlights: Programmed and tuned an autonomous mobile robot (AMR) unit powered by a Raspberry Pi 5 single-board computer running Robot Operating System 2 (ROS2).
Configured modular ROS2 publisher/subscriber nodes for real-time motor actuation, PWM driver loops, and telemetry streaming on embedded Linux.
Interfaced onboard monocular camera feeds with OpenCV pipelines for visual marker tracking, target acquisition, and spatial orientation.

flagship_projects.name: TrendGuard-200: Multi-Asset Quantitative Risk Engine
highlights: Architected a quantitative signal generation and backtesting engine in Python, evaluating multi-asset momentum regimes across an 8-year OHLC dataset.
Accelerated computation cycles by 90% through vectorized NumPy and Pandas operations, achieving a 72.7% win rate.
Structured strict drawdown-containment filters using dynamic position sizing and multi-timeframe moving average boundaries (21, 50, 200 SMA) alongside RSI and VWAP triggers.

flagship_projects.name: CardsFinders Financial Tool Suite
highlights: Deployed a financial comparison and evaluation web engine on Cloudflare Pages, configuring custom DNS architectures, edge-caching layers, and domain-level email routing.
Engineered structured data tables and client-side filtering tools to evaluate credit card rewards and financial products.

flagship_projects.name: Event-Driven Web Experiments & Production Utilities
highlights: Built interactive client-side web applications exploring asynchronous API polling, event-driven frontend interaction models, and distributed edge delivery.
Developed industrial production micro-utilities including image-sequence-renamer.pages.dev to automate asset management workflows for manufacturing and digital catalog teams.

flagship_projects.name: Photovoltaic Sensorless Solar Tracker
highlights: Engineered a dual-axis solar tracking algorithm that eliminates external light-dependent resistors (LDRs) and auxiliary optical sensors.

Utilized the intrinsic photovoltaic voltage and current characteristics of the solar panel itself as the diagnostic light-intensity sensor, dynamically calculating maximum power point vectors to actuate motor positioners with minimal component overhead.

flagship_projects.name: Gas Detection Safety System
highlights: Built an embedded gas-hazard detection circuit integrating an Arduino Uno with an MQ-2 electrochemical gas sensor.
Programmed analog-to-digital threshold comparison logic, automatic alarm actuation, and sensor calibration routines to trigger emergency alerts under volatile gas leak scenarios.
